subject: T2 Stage/Preview tone-mapping correction (E12 follow-up)

before.source: Threlte <Canvas> default, applied to the renderer createRenderer returns
before.method: Mount each production Canvas with the prop removed; read renderer.toneMapping. Both report 6.

after.method: apps/editor/tests/lib/render/canvas-tone-mapping.test.ts mounts both production Canvases through their shipped createRenderer callbacks (Threlte's renderer context is the shipped one; only the GPU implementation is doubled) and reads the renderer Threlte configured.

exposureNote: Neither the shared factory, Threlte's <Canvas> nor the product code writes toneMappingExposure; the effective value is three's default 1.0.

chart.condition: Gate A neutral reference: one white directional light at intensity PI at normal incidence, MeshLambertMaterial, opaque sRGB chart, exposure 1.0, black background. readPixels immediately after render on the default framebuffer.
chart.redrawPath: createManagedWebGLRenderer (production factory), the same renderer the Canvases receive

images.what: The same chart under both pipelines, side by side: AgX (left, what the Canvases inherited) and NoToneMapping (right, Gate A accepted).
images.retention: Visual evidence for the correction PR; the capture route was removed before commit.

limits: The chart is synthetic and the light is one white directional at normal incidence; it proves the transform, not a specific artwork or a coloured light.
The readback is the default framebuffer of the capture page, not the Stage's own canvas: the Stage's scene content is A1's fidelity check.
Snapshot colour space (Gate A finding F5) is unchanged and remains E6's.
